encoding_equivalence: Exactly-one candidate per domain already holds. For each domain-cell occupancy variable o, every candidate using that cell implies o. AMO over conflicting domain occupancy variables excludes exactly simultaneous incompatible chosen occupants. Conversely any compatible candidate assignment extends by setting o to actual occupancy. Reverse implications are unnecessary. Legal endpoint sharing still uses the same pair-restricted exclusions.
